seen.note: Which CODEOWNERS rule actually wins per changed file, who gets requested, which lines GitHub silently skips. Occupant hunt 2026-08-04 named and empty of web tools: hmarr/codeowners, mszostok/codeowners-validator, orsinium-labs/owners, topfreegames/codeowners-verifier, nmusolino/codeowners, multimediallc/codeowners-plus - all CLI/library/Action shaped. Semantics BORROWED from hmarr/codeowners (MIT) @11d3ff26 and verified against ~310k differential pairs with zero divergences, 171/171 reference corpus, 13/13 GitHub-documented cases, ~130 XSS positions clean, cookieless. Two checker defects, one fix cycle spent, targeted re-check PARTIAL.
seen.rebuild_constraint: The matcher is DONE and heavily proven (~500,000 differential pairs vs Go/RE2 with zero divergences, 171/171 reference corpus, 13/13 GitHub-documented, 2,500 generated files end-to-end with zero winner or skip-set mismatches). Do NOT rebuild it. What failed is the page around it, and all four remaining defects are one root cause: aggregate input is bounded, the DIMENSIONS that drive work are not, and the browser cannot be metered once JavaScript hands over. (1) VALIDATE EVERY DIMENSION AT THE DOOR before any split/trim/parse/compile, counting without materialising: total chars, LINE COUNT of both boxes (scan for newlines with an early bail - do not split first), per-line length, PER-OWNER-TOKEN length (this is the 23,701 ms hole: `** @` + 100,000 'a'), per-pattern length. Zero work before validation. (2) BOUND THE OUTPUT BY CONSTRUCTION and measure PAINT (dispatch to double-rAF), not a JS canary - 810 ms dispatch-to-paint was measured at exactly the maximum the page advertised as safe. (3) REPLICATE THE REFERENCE'S LIMITS, not only its semantics: Go's bufio.Scanner drops any line >= 65,536 bytes AND silently abandons every rule after it; this port kept going and showed a wrong owner. Replicate it (it is a footgun worth surfacing) or refuse the line - never quietly diverge. (4) Only then re-derive the timing number from measurement at the page's own stated maximum. (5) Start from lib/checks/codeowners-oracle.json - oracles, the Go differential recipe, and six rounds of regression notes. HARD RULE LEARNED: never put a person's name in code, a comment or a commit message. lib/ is inlined into every ship page, so a lib/ comment ships; and git history is additive, so fixing the tip does not remove it - a checker fetched it back over HTTP from an ancestor commit. The branch had to be squashed and force-pushed.

plain.what: A free web page: paste your CODEOWNERS file and the files a pull request touches, and it says exactly who GitHub will ask to review each one - and which of your rules it is quietly ignoring.
plain.solves: CODEOWNERS picks reviewers on every PR, but the LAST matching rule wins rather than the most specific one, so teams believe a rule is protecting a directory when a broader rule below it has been overriding it for months. Malformed lines are skipped in silence.
plain.money: Not published. The matching engine is correct and heavily proven and the page is secure and private, but its printed promise about never freezing is still not true, so it did not earn a stage. Returns as a rebuild with a design constraint rather than another patch.

seen.note: XSS fixed and confirmed dead; 56/56 vs GitHub cheat sheet, 0 inverted verdicts. Fails on a glob-engine ReDoS that a static complexity budget cannot bound. REVISIT AS A REBUILD, not a new candidate: replace globToRegex/gmatch with a linear-time non-backtracking matcher (two-pointer + backtrack memo, or DP), verify against the existing 56-case published oracle and the ~67M-pair differential harness.
seen.rebuild_constraint: Replace globToRegex/gmatch with a LINEAR-TIME non-backtracking matcher (two-pointer with backtrack memo, or DP over pattern x path). BORROW: port nektos/act pkg/workflowpattern (MIT, correct GitHub semantics, scores 49/49) rather than hand-roll — hand-rolling is what produced the XSS then the ReDoS. VERIFY against lib/checks/gha-filter-oracle.json (46 published pairs) + lib/checks/redos-probes.json (must resolve <50ms each, no UI freeze) + lib/checks/xss-payloads.json. Add the LIVE analytics beacon (ship 002 predates it). Kill-criterion in per-path visits, not tool-runs. [2026-08-03 CORRECTION, from reading the port source rather than trusting the plan: act is linear-time because Go's regexp is RE2, NOT because of its pattern translation. PatternToRegex emits ordinary regex text. A VERBATIM JS PORT WOULD REINTRODUCE THE ReDoS, because JS RegExp backtracks. Port act's SEMANTICS line-for-line; execute them on a Thompson NFA / Pike-VM state-set simulation, never on JS RegExp.]
